previous.title: Complete bidegree-(3,3) two-pair SIC classification
previous.scope: Determine whether every bidegree-(3,3) all-order pure-moment point is SIC-safe, or exhibit a fixed multiplier with an infinite nonzero mixed tail. This decides whether the known bidegree-(4,4) counterexample has minimum balanced bidegree. Moment--nullcone equality is already false: SIC2B33RDS is a full-rank semistable all-order Rodrigues survivor, but its explicit integration-by-parts cutoff proves that orbit safe. Rank one and the one-sided nullcone are safe. SIC2B33ODD20261116 now closes the entire ten-dimensional odd-harmonic Sym^6+Sym^2 slice, including mixtures and boundaries, with the sharp strict cutoff m>deg_(Z,Y)Q. The remaining structural question couples spherical H2 (Sym^4) to H3+H1; the common cubic radial lift would require sqrt(x.x). The transfer inherits the retained homogeneous Gaussian cubic theorem's independent-review boundary. SIC2B33SP9 now proves that every mixed standard-basis coefficient support of size at most nine is SIC-safe, so any counterexample has at least ten nonzero coefficients in that basis. At size nine, the earlier rectangle, fringe, cross, three-line, and full-line theorems close 3554 supports; SIC2B33FI9 closes the 816 supports of type (3,2,2,2)^2, including two unique rational rank-three fixed-flag points; and the final exact QQ unit calculation closes the other 7050 full-incidence supports. Thus all 11420 supports in all 2924 discrete transpose/reversal orbits are closed. This support census is basis-dependent and does not classify the dense continuous diagonal-SL_2 locus. SIC2B33AW14 excludes the normalized anti-Weyl branch, SIC2C3R2FP9 proves that its isolated rank-two nine-moment point fails already at mu10 and that the corrected rank-two system has no anti-Weyl point, SIC2C3R2HUR and SIC2C3R2HURF3 exclude the four complete fibres lambda=-1,0,1,2 and the doubly exceptional mu2-pivot branch on one generic rank-two Hurwitz channel chart, SIC2C3R2HURJ6 classifies the unlocalized five-parameter exact-rank-two coefficient slice b0=0,b1=1 and proves that its only all-order point is fixed-flag one-sided and SIC-safe, SIC2C3R2HURM1 gives the exact irreducible component and mu4--mu5 subresultant layers on the P1-open A=0 divisor, SIC2C3R2PC6 classifies the complete exact-rank-two reversal-parity family, and SIC2B33NQL locally isolates the Rodrigues orbit on one null-quadratic chart. Existing exact work also closes every pure irreducible summand, the diagonal slice, the Sym^4+Sym^2 non-null branch, a four-parameter hardest-boundary family, and all five corrected t0=0 strata. On the remaining normalized non-null branch, exact quotient arithmetic and specialized Fitting calculations exclude substantial divisors and fibers, but the unspecialized Q component, other border factors, and later corrected moments are not globally classified. Away from the four excluded fibres and the stated coefficient slice on the generic rank-two Hurwitz chart, later common moments on the P1-open A=0 components, the other complementary mu2-pivot open, localization boundaries, other channel charts, the projective normalization boundary, and exceptional cubic-pencil divisors remain open. The simple-root coefficient slice is not an independent channel-SL_2 normalization because the relevant symmetry is diagonal. The remaining mixed-parity portions of the null-quadratic stratum, the F2=0 boundary, and dense ranks three and four also remain open; spherical H2 here denotes Sym^4, while the historical binary-quadratic label F2 denotes Sym^2. Finite-field units and bounded searches are evidence only unless lifted to characteristic zero and all omitted chart boundaries are covered. Machine-readable narrowing results incorporated into this programme: SIC2B33C9, SIC2B33F9, SIC2B33FI9, SIC2B33FL9, SIC2B33I, SIC2B33L9, SIC2B33M9, SIC2B33P8, SIC2B33QRS, SIC2B33R7, SIC2B33R9, SIC2B33SP8, SIC2B33SP9, SIC2B33U6, SIC2B33X9, SIC2C3R2HURF3, SIC2C3R2HURJ6, SIC2C3R2HURM1, SIC2C3R2PC6, SIC2C3PF14M, SIC2C3PF14Q0, SIC2C3PFCM, SIC2C3PFCQ0. SIC2B33EULER20261116 exhausts the supplied conformal-Euler mixed-cubic architecture: every pure phase there is one-sided or scalar/orthogonal Rodrigues, with the sharp full marked cutoff m>3 coordinate-degree Q. The whole sixteen-coefficient grading test is a four-unknown linear system. Any new semistable pure orbit must fail that certificate. It is not proved that the complementary pure semistable locus is empty or safe; proving its exhaustion or marked control is the current structural milestone. The full positive theorem, which would make balanced bidegree four minimal for the known failure, remains the completion target. SIC2B33JET20261116 supplies the sharp all-order deformation window10r. SIC2B33LOCAL20261116 now closes the full Rodrigues local deformation question: its reduced pure germ is exactly the scalar/orthogonal orbit, already cut out locally by the first12 moments, with transverse first12 length22/index10 and full ordinary local prefix<=90. Its orbit closure is a complete safe four-dimensional irreducible pure component. The remaining global target concerns other semistable components away from this orbit; neither another infinitesimal branch search there nor its known local isolation supplies global exhaustion. SIC2B33CYCLIC20261116 now constructs the entire oriented cyclic-frame quotient on D=det(v,Bv,B^2v) nonzero, retaining nilpotent B and the full cubic, with a complete15-variable/four-relation normalized input and all first12 exact moment circuits. The global Krull dimension and length of A12 remain uncomputed; its initial length66 target is now disproved by SIC2B33CYCLICEXTRA20261116. SIC2B33HILBERT20261116 proves that twelve moments have additional semistable prefix candidates globally by residues659043 versus11; they may lie on D0 and need not be all-order pure. SIC2B33NILGATE20261116 proves the exact fourteen-power membership equivalence and rank-three/42-column module formulation. SIC2B33CYCLICEXTRA20261116 then proves s0^10 is not in I12: a nonempty zero-dimensional square seven-equation special fibre lifts by the regular-sequence DVR argument to characteristic-zero first12 candidates on D nonzero with non-null H1. SIC2B33CYCLICLENGTH20261116 now transfers the full scheme length: global DVR torsion-freeness lifts all9168 chart classes, and the common rank6/rank4 finite etale cover gives a normalized characteristic-zero contribution>=13752 with all multiplicities. Adding the disjoint Rodrigues length66 gives dim_C A12>=13818. This trusts the retained exact msolve computation and does not compute full global length or give another pure phase; the retained anti-Weyl theorem already excludes this entire candidate chart at mu14. The mu14 exclusion makes mu14 a unit on this entire characteristic-zero anti-halfturn scheme, removing its full thickening. The next cyclic exhaustion gate is full A14 against3d14, including mu13. Exact moment input through14 is retained with1341228 nodes and direct controls for both new moments. Actual local d14, global finiteness and exact A12/A14 lengths are uncomputed;66 can be reused only if d14=22 is proved by actual filtered local reduction. The17-equation/15-variable global A14 presentation cannot use the square-system modular lifting shortcut without further justification. D0 is to be stratified by cyclic rank0,1,2 and restricted-form rank, with cubic couplings unrestricted. Local prefix90 does not bound global exhaustion.

proof_audit.G_function: Common exponential denominator bound + D-finiteness + Cauchy estimates at EVERY embedding give strict G-functions. No convergence from integral coefficients or one convergent unit.
proof_audit.induction: Actual L-span of normalized original periods is a quotient of a finite sum of pullbacks of ACTUAL minimal G-modules. Original scalar V injects restriction of scalars of exponential twist. No false injectivity of L tensor V->L V or full image-kernel computation.
proof_audit.zero_action: For one nonzero globally regular ACTUAL scalar period,both it and its normalized G-function give regular actual L-spans. Their determinants differ by-r*dpsi;higher poles impossible,projective psi constant0. Any-rank result,not only rank1.
proof_audit.field_descent: Finite squarefree leading factors,division witnesses,infinity degree bounds and denominator/leading/discriminant/resultant guards spread a VERIFIED Fuchsian annihilator. Preserve one nonzero original-period coefficient and one action coefficient;closed number-field specialization contradicts number-field theorem. No actual fiber-rank equality assumed.
proof_audit.regular_core: Over number fields and psi0,every actual conjugate-convergent Laurent period is a G-function after finite shift,and every globally regular period converges by Frobenius. These give exact maximal regular-core equality and full regularity criterion. Convergence oracle and Gaussian transcendental realization NOT supplied.
